info.name: Premisave Developer Service
info.description:
Premisave Developer Service: developer accounts, apps, API keys and the public /v1 entry.

Setup: import the collection, set base_url_dev, run Sign up (or Sign in); the token is saved as access_token. Confirm the email address (folder Email and password) before Create business. Run Create business, then Create app (sandbox): the key and secret are saved as api_key and api_secret and used by folder 04. Folder 05 needs admin_api_key (DEVELOPER_INTERNAL_API_KEY on the server) and developer_id.

A secret is shown once. If you lose it, create or rotate a key.

request.description: Required: email, firstName, lastName, password (at least 10 characters), country (2 letters) and acceptTerms (must be true). Optional: middleName, phoneNumber (7 to 15 digits), companyName, marketingOptIn. A username is generated for you (see the response). 409 EMAIL_TAKEN if the email is used. A confirmation email is sent when a mail server is set. No token is returned: show data.message and send the developer to the sign in page, then run Sign in. Sign in works before the email is confirmed.
5 failed attempts lock the account for 15 minutes (423 ACCOUNT_LOCKED).

request.description: Every field is optional; only the ones sent change, and nothing changes unless every field sent is valid. Send an empty string to clear middleName, phoneNumber, companyName, the address fields or timezone. firstName, lastName, country and username cannot be cleared.

3 to 30 characters, lower case letters, digits, dots, hyphens and underscores, starting with a letter. 400 for a bad format or a reserved word, 409 USERNAME_TAKEN if taken, 429 RATE_LIMITED if changed in the last 7 days.
Returns available and a reason: OK, CURRENT, TAKEN, RESERVED or INVALID.
Earlier tokens stop working. The response carries a fresh token. Afterwards set developer_password to the new value.
Ends the token used for this call. Other devices stay signed in. Calling it again with the same token is 401.
Ends every token of this account, including this one. Sign in again afterwards.

Creates the merchant in the wallet service, with its merchant number and a draft onboarding application. One business per account (409 MERCHANT_EXISTS). 403 EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED until the email address is confirmed.
Sandbox apps use one of these.

item.name: 00 Email and password

request.description: Paste the token from the link in the confirmation email (...verify-email?token=THIS). Works once. 400 INVALID_TOKEN if unknown, used or expired. With DEVELOPER_MAIL_LOG_LINKS=true and no mail server the link is in the service log.
409 INVALID_STATE if already confirmed. 429 RATE_LIMITED with retryAfterSeconds if asked within 60 seconds, or more than 5 times an hour.
No sign in needed. Always answers 200 with the same message, whether or not the address has an account.
Always answers 200 with the same message. If the address has an active account a link to {portal}/reset-password?token=... is emailed. Good for 60 minutes.
Uses the token from the reset email. A weak password is refused before the link is spent. Every session ends; sign in again with the new password and set developer_password to it.

item.description: Links arrive by email and point at the portal. Copy the token from the link into email_token.

item.name: 00 Social sign in

request.description: The providers that are configured on the server, for example google, facebook, github.

Set oauth_provider to google, facebook or github, and oauth_redirect_uri to an address listed in DEVELOPER_OAUTH_REDIRECT_URIS. Open the returned authorizationUrl (saved as oauth_authorization_url) in a browser, sign in with the provider, and copy the code from the address the provider sends you back to.

Returns the usual session plus newAccount and provider. A code works once and only for a short time. 409 ACCOUNT_EXISTS when the provider does not vouch for an email that already has an account (Facebook), 422 OAUTH_EMAIL_REQUIRED when the provider gives no usable email.

item.description: The code comes from the provider after a browser sign in, so this folder cannot run unattended.

request.description: Base64 in the JSON body, up to 12 MB. Needs Google Drive configured on the wallet, otherwise 503.
422 APPLICATION_INCOMPLETE lists everything still missing.

item.description: Pass-through to the wallet service for the signed in developer's own business. Staff review is done on the wallet service.

request.description: Returns the first key and its secret once. The collection saves them as api_key and api_secret. A wallet cannot be sent for a sandbox app.
Needs production approved (403 LIVE_NOT_ENABLED before), the business's own number and the wallet account number or id. 409 WALLET_ALREADY_LINKED if a production app already uses that wallet.
403 FORBIDDEN if Premisave staff suspended it.
The secret is shown once. Up to 5 active keys per app.
The old key keeps working for 24 hours as ROTATING. Run it from the key you want to replace.

item.name: 04 Public API (key and secret)

request.description: Uses api_key and api_secret from a sandbox app as HTTP Basic.
The same call with X-Client-Key and X-Client-Secret.
Use a production app's key. A sandbox key here returns 403 ENVIRONMENT_MISMATCH.

item.description: Set api_key and api_secret from a sandbox app's key. Everything after /v1/{live|sandbox} is the wallet's commercial API (COMMERCIAL_API_ENDPOINTS.md).

request.description: The developer cannot lift a suspension placed here.
